source='''def transform(grid):
    size = 4
    n = len(grid)
    top = left = None
    for r in range(n - size + 1):
        for c in range(len(grid[0]) - size + 1):
            if all(grid[i][j] == 3 for i in range(r, r + size) for j in range(c, c + size)):
                top, left = r, c
                break
        if top is not None:
            break
    opposite_top = n - size - top
    opposite_left = len(grid[0]) - size - left
    return [
        [grid[i][j] for j in range(opposite_left + size - 1, opposite_left - 1, -1)]
        for i in range(opposite_top + size - 1, opposite_top - 1, -1)
    ]
'''
